coverage.json.method: counts of verified rows in web/data/test_points.json (each row carries source_id + locator); built by physics/validate/export.py

limits.json.method: export of physics/data/limits.yaml; each limit cites a key in web/data/sources.json

missions.json.method: export of physics/data/missions.yaml; each mission atmosphere cites a key in web/data/sources.json

params/droplet.json.method: fitted by physics/fit/fit_droplet.py on verified split=train FLEX rows

params/suppression.json.method: fitted by physics/fit/fit_suppression.py on verified split=train FLEX rows

properties.json.method: export of physics/data/properties.yaml; each value's `source` is a key in web/data/sources.json

psi/bre_atmospheres.json.method: parsed from PSI-20 Experimental table + PSI-20 API objective by physics/pipeline/ingest_psi.py

psi/flex_crosscheck.json.method: value-by-value comparison PSI-69 Experimental table vs NTRS Table IX (physics/pipeline/ingest_psi.py)

psi_catalog.json.method: PSI API responses (metadata, DOI, file search) + sha256 manifest; physics/pipeline/fetch_psi.py

sources.json.method: bibliographic metadata (year, DOI, URL) of every cited source

thermo.json.method: GRI-Mech 3.0 NASA-7 polynomials parsed from physics/data/thermo30.dat by emberphys.thermo

validation/droplet_K.json.method: physics/validate/run_all.py: model predictions vs held-out verified rows (never fitted on them)

validation/droplet_dext.json.method: physics/validate/run_all.py: model predictions vs held-out verified rows (never fitted on them)

validation/loi_curves.json.method: physics/validate/run_all.py: model predictions vs held-out verified rows (never fitted on them)

validation/summary.json.method: physics/validate/run_all.py: model predictions vs held-out verified rows (never fitted on them)

validation_targets.json.method: export of physics/data/validation_targets.yaml (published headline values with source keys)
